parts.label: whole
parts.display_text: A sample initially contains only xenon-142 nuclei. After 6.0 s, the number of nuclei that have decayed is 31 times the number of xenon-142 nuclei remaining. Calculate the half-life, showing your reasoning.

answer.text: For every remaining nucleus, 31 have decayed, so the remaining fraction is 1/32 = (1/2)⁵. Five half-lives have passed in 6.0 s. The half-life is 6.0/5 = 1.2 s.
